# use-everywhere

> State, messages, presence and leader election that exist in every tab, window
> and worker on an origin, with a React API. `useSharedState` is `useState` whose
> value lives in every tab; per-key [counter, clientId] clocks give last-writer-
> wins with a deterministic tie-break, and a hello/snapshot handshake hydrates
> tabs opened later. There is no Provider and no server. Two transports behind
> one library — BroadcastChannel for same-origin, postMessage for an explicit,
> typed, 1:1 cross-origin window channel; shared state deliberately never crosses
> origins. React >= 18. MIT. Ships ESM and CommonJS.

This file is the map, not the manual. It exists because an agent that reaches
this project through the repository tree — rather than through an install or the
docs site — lands on `AGENTS.md`, which is written for someone editing the
library and answers almost nothing about using it.

Deliberately pointer-only. Every fact about an API belongs to exactly one of the
files below, all of which are checked against the source; restating any of it
here would create a copy that nothing verifies and that drifts on the first
rename.

## Packages

Each ships its `llms.txt` inside its npm tarball, so after an install it is
readable straight out of `node_modules` with no network. That is the file to
read when you are writing calling code.

- [use-everywhere](packages/react/llms.txt): the React hooks, and the only
  install a React app needs — it re-exports the whole of core.
- [@use-everywhere/core](packages/core/llms.txt): the same engine with no
  framework attached. Use it directly only when you are not using React.
- [eslint-plugin-use-everywhere](packages/eslint-plugin/llms.txt): the rules for
  the three mistakes that fail silently — module-scope definitions, stable
  names, cloneable values, leader-effect captures.
- [@use-everywhere/test-utils](packages/test-utils/llms.txt): several tabs in one
  process, for testing. jsdom cannot do this; see `AGENTS.md`.
- [use-everywhere-codemod](packages/codemod/llms.txt): the migration tool for
  the 1.0 renames. Run once over a `0.x` codebase; not a dependency of anything.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://rxova.org/packages/use-everywhere/): every page also
  exists as raw markdown — add `.md` to any URL.
- [llms.txt](https://rxova.org/packages/use-everywhere/llms.txt): the docs index,
  under 24 kB by budget.
- [llms-full.txt](https://rxova.org/packages/use-everywhere/llms-full.txt): every
  page inlined, when one fetch should be the whole thing.
- [Compared to the alternatives](https://rxova.org/packages/use-everywhere/learn/comparison.md):
  hand-rolled BroadcastChannel, localStorage events, Zustand, Jotai, Redux — and
  where this library is the wrong answer.
- [Error codes](https://rxova.org/packages/use-everywhere/errors.md): every
  `UEnnnn` a dev build can emit.
